Given the risk profile and systemic symptoms, an occult malignancy is the single most likely cause, with primary bronchogenic (lung) carcinoma being the leading specific diagnosis in a long-term smoker presenting with unexplained weight loss and fatigue despite normal routine labs.

[DIAGNOSIS]
Primary lung cancer (bronchogenic carcinoma) — occult malignancy most likely causing fatigue and unintentional weight loss.
